intended_object: The set of slot (edge) indices that have zero length in a degenerate subdivision spec and also lie on the "left" side of a core vertex cut. This comes from the docstring and from how the module uses it.
explanation: This is a helper set used inside the library's proof. It is the intersection `d.zeroSlotSet ∩ cut.leftSlots`. It exists only to define `repLeft` (via `compFold`) and to carry the closed-orthant cut-transport argument for the Brill–Noether certificate. It has no standard counterpart in the literature. It is not a general notion that Mathlib would define either. It is an implementation detail of a certificate-checking proof. The body does match its docstring: it gives exactly the vanishing slots that lie in the left side of the cut.
